description: Search Twitch, fetch top live streams, browse categories (games), or look up channels, videos, and clips by ID/URL. No Twitch login is required.

authToken.description: Optional Twitch OAuth user-token (the value of the `auth-token` cookie on twitch.tv when logged in). Increases rate limits and can unlock subscriber-only data. Not required for any mode.
authToken.title: Twitch OAuth token (optional)

categorySlug.description: Twitch category (game) slug, e.g. `just-chatting`, `league-of-legends`, `valorant`. Find it from the URL: twitch.tv/directory/category/<slug>.
categorySlug.title: Category slug (mode=byCategory or topClips)

channelName.description: Twitch channel login (the part after twitch.tv/, e.g. `lirik`, `shroud`, `pokimane`).
channelName.title: Channel login / name (mode=byChannel)

clipPeriod.description: For `topClips` and `byChannel` clip lists: time window over which clips were created.
clipPeriod.title: Clip time window

clipSlug.description: Twitch clip slug, e.g. `AcceptablePleasantAuberginePanicVis-EVdxDQ1vsQAQZpBS`. Find it from twitch.tv/<channel>/clip/<slug>.
clipSlug.title: Clip slug (mode=byClip)

containsKeyword.description: Substring filter applied case-insensitively to stream/video/clip titles.
containsKeyword.title: Title contains keyword

includeChannelClips.description: When `mode=byChannel`, also fetch and emit top clips for the channel.
includeChannelClips.title: Include clips (mode=byChannel)

includeChannelVideos.description: When `mode=byChannel`, also fetch and emit recent VODs for the channel.
includeChannelVideos.title: Include VODs (mode=byChannel)

language.description: Filter live streams (and search results) to a specific broadcast language. Applies to `topStreams`, `byCategory`, and `search`. Leave on `(any)` for no filter.
language.title: Broadcast language

minViewCount.description: Drop VODs and clips with fewer total views than this.
minViewCount.title: Min total views (videos / clips filter)

minViewersCount.description: Drop live streams with fewer concurrent viewers than this. Applies to `topStreams` and `byCategory`.
minViewersCount.title: Min concurrent viewers (live streams filter)

enumTitles: Lookup a single VOD by video ID
Lookup a single clip by slug
Resolve and scrape a Twitch URL
mode.title: Mode

searchQuery.description: Free-text query for `mode=search` — matches channels, games, and videos.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

searchType.description: Restrict search results to a single result type. `all` returns channels + games + videos.
searchType.title: Search result type (mode=search)

streamType.description: Restrict the VOD list returned for a channel to a specific broadcast type. Leave blank for all types.
streamType.title: VOD type filter (mode=byChannel)

twitchUrls.description: Direct Twitch URLs to resolve. Supports channel pages (twitch.tv/<channel>), VOD pages (twitch.tv/videos/<id>), clip pages (twitch.tv/<channel>/clip/<slug>), and category pages (twitch.tv/directory/category/<slug>).
twitchUrls.title: Twitch URLs (mode=byUrl)

useApifyProxy.description: Route requests through the Apify proxy from the start. When OFF the actor still auto-engages the proxy if the first direct attempt emits zero records, so leaving this OFF saves cost on most runs.
useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify proxy

videoId.description: Twitch VOD ID, e.g. `2766365638`. Find it from twitch.tv/videos/<id>.
videoId.title: Video ID (mode=byVideo)

videoSort.description: How to sort the channel's VODs.
videoSort.title: Video sort order (mode=byChannel)

title: Twitch Scraper Input
